name: hzcrh4-cancel-verified-build
goal: Cancelling a verified artifact build stops its owned process tree, releases admission, and removes the source snapshot.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: An admitted setup starts a child. Cancelling verification must stop that child and remove its exact-commit snapshot.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The retained-output case verifies success and a missing file. The SDK fixture checked pre-abort only. The snapshot case now waits on a real setup descendant, then checks child exit and snapshot teardown.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Exact snapshot regression failed with descendant and snapshot still present. Recorded on harbor-mbp-2.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: An admitted verification process propagates cancellation to its checks and preserves its Bun signal handler.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged regression passed on harbor-mbp-2. The packaged CLI separately passed cleanup from the real Node SDK.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
